edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Aegis Assault has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Astral Flight (W): 22s at rank 1 — his only out, and your W stun cancels the flight mid-air; he is a stationary battery while it is down. - Falling Star: 120/110/100s stun — it cancels your Aegis channel, so E after he ults. - Your E has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: His Q is a channel — one W stun shuts the breath off mid-stream and the trade is yours for free.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Singularity's center executes below a threshold — never fight low inside the black hole; the pull does the rest for him.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: Full stacks flip it: massive HP, longer Q melt and a screen-wide R — your one-target dive stops punching through. Close before now.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol is a pure stacking scaler with no early kill pressure; your E-W-Q combo bursts him before his Breath of Light (Q) stacks matter. He has no dash and only a slow from Astral Flight (E) on a long cooldown, so close the gap and delete him. This is where you must build your lead or he snowballs his passive off you.
